name: Gene Munster
zh_summary: @munster_gene 認為個人 AI 對 Google 的威脅大於 ChatGPT 曾經造成的威脅。令人意外的是，自 Muse 推出以來 $GOOG 股價上升 7%，而納斯達克僅上升 3%。ChatGPT 主要回答 Google 本來沒有貨幣化的問題，而助手會進行交易；Google 建立了 2500 億美元的搜尋業務，正是靠引導這些交易。Google 的應對是 Task（前稱 Spark），問題是它能否像 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 一樣，成功將搜尋流量導向自己的 AI 功能。
text:
Personal AI is a bigger threat to Google than ChatGPT ever was.

Surprisingly, shares of $GOOG are up 7% since Muse launched, versus a 3% gain for the Nasdaq.

ChatGPT mostly answered questions Google wasn't monetizing anyway. Assistants transact. Google built a $250B search business on routing those transactions.

Google’s response is Task, a Gemini feature formerly known as Spark. The question is: can Google do with Task what it did with AI Overviews and AI Mode by successfully redirecting Search traffic to its own AI features?

name: The Kobeissi Letter
zh_summary: @KobeissiLetter：美國CPI已連續67個月高於聯準會2%目標，上次低於目標是2021年1月；美元價值下跌22.5%，2021年100美元的商品現需129美元。
text:
It's official.

US CPI inflation has now been above the Fed's 2% target for 67 consecutive months.

The last time inflation was below 2% in the US was in January 2021, amid a global economic lockdown.

Over this period, the value of the US Dollar has declined by -22.5%.

In other words, it now costs $129 to purchase the same goods and services that cost $100 in 2021.

Compounding inflation has become the new norm in the US.

Asset owners are the only winners.

text:
